description: Use when the user asks which mail servers a domain uses or why it cannot receive mail. Returns MX hosts by preference with addresses, null MX and implicit MX. Provider name: mail_provider; reverse DNS of the servers: domain_health (needs an API key). Ex: 'What are the MX records of example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
